[[Moca FC]] 8-1 [[Delfines del Este FC]] | prevseason = [[2017 Liga Dominicana de Fútbol|2017]] | nextseason = [[2019 Liga Dominicana de Fútbol|2019]] | updated = }} The '''2018 [[Liga Dominicana de Fútbol]]''' season (known as the ''LDF Banco Popular'' for sponsorship reasons) is the fourth season of professional [[Association football|football]] in the [[Dominican Republic]]. [[Atlántico FC]] are the reigning champions, having won this first title [[2017 Liga Dominicana de Fútbol|last season]]. The season started on 7 April 2018 and ended on 27 October 2018.[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesd/domrep2018.html Dominican Republic 2018], RSSSF.com ==Team changes== While there is no promotion or relegation involving this league, there were changes to the composition of the league from last season. [[Bauger FC]] have left the league following last season. Meanwhile, three new teams have joined the league: [[Don Bosco Jarabacoa FC|Jarabacoa FC]], [[Inter de Bayaguana|Inter RD]], and [[Atlético de San Francisco]]. Thus, the league now has 12 teams in total. ==Format changes== The format of the competition has changed for this season. The regular season will still consist of a double round robin between the participating teams. After this, a Liguilla round will be played between the top six finishers of the regular season, with a single round robin between the teams. The top 4 finishers of this phase will move on to the knockout phase of the playoffs, where the champion will be decided. The top team at the end of the regular season along with the playoff champion will qualify for the [[2019 Caribbean Club Championship]]. ==Stadia and locations== {{Location map+ |Dominican Republic |width=400 |float=right |caption=Locations of Liga Dominicana de Fútbol clubs |places= {{Location map~ |Dominican Republic |lat=19.7807|long=-70.6871 |label=[[Atlantico FC]] |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Dominican Republic |lat=18.4188 |long=-70.1030 |label=[[Club Atlético San Cristóbal|Atlético San Cristóbal]] |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Dominican Republic |lat=19.3 |long=-70.25 |label=[[Atlético de San Francisco|San Francisco]] |position=right}} {{Location map~ |Dominican Republic |lat=19.2200 |long=-70.5299 |label=[[Atlético Vega Real]] |position=right}} {{Location map~ |Dominican Republic|lat=19.4667 |long=-70.7000 |label=[[Cibao FC]] |position=left}} {{Location map~ |Dominican Republic |lat=18.5000 |long=-69.9839 |label=[[Club Atlético Pantoja|Atlético Pantoja]]
